title: Search for the missing team brought in Sturgis deputies and a state trooper
summary: Mario Woods tells of Search for the missing team brought in Sturgis deputies and a state trooper, about 1977 (learned in 2021) at Ellsworth AFB missile field / Sturgis, South Dakota, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.
place_text: Ellsworth AFB missile field / Sturgis, South Dakota

tellings.link_reason: Both tell of the 1977 search for the missing team, in which wing security brought in two Sturgis deputies and a state trooper, a fact Mario learned in 2021.

as_told.title: Sturgis sheriff's deputies and a state trooper sent to find them

plain: Mario Woods, a former guard at an American nuclear missile base, says his security team went missing for a time in 1977 in the missile fields around Ellsworth Air Force Base, South Dakota, during what he describes as an abduction. He says he only learned in 2021 that base security had asked for outside help in finding them, and that two deputy sheriffs from the town of Sturgis and a state trooper were sent out. In one telling he points to a sheriff's dispatch log from Meade County as his source. If true, it would show the team's disappearance was serious enough to call in local police.
